name: abency-seo-search-console
description: SEO reporting, keyword research and rank tracking from Google Search Console and Google Analytics for marketing agencies and their client brands, from ChatGPT, through Abency.

interface.longDescription: SEO for marketing agencies and freelancers who manage several client websites. Get SEO reports from Google Search Console and Google Analytics, find the queries and pages to improve, research keywords with search volume and difficulty, analyze competitors and track keyword rankings over time. Monitor local SEO with Google Business Profile views, calls and reviews, audit Google Tag Manager containers, and write or optimize WordPress posts and SEO titles. Changes to published WordPress pages become proposals that a person approves inside WordPress. Every request is scoped to the brands of your Abency organization.
defaultPrompt: Give me this month's SEO report for my main brand
Find keyword ideas for my client's new service page
Which Search Console queries are on page 2 and worth improving?

positive.prompt: Give me last month's SEO report for Abency: clicks, impressions, average position and the top queries.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports last month's Search Console totals with the change against the previous month and a table of the top queries with clicks, impressions, CTR and position.

positive.prompt: Which Search Console queries for Abency rank on page two and are worth improving?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists queries with an average position between about 11 and 20 and meaningful impressions, with the page that ranks and a suggestion for each.

positive.prompt: Find keyword ideas around "social media scheduler for agencies" with monthly search volume in Spain.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns related keyword ideas with monthly search volume (and competition or CPC when available) for Spain, grouped or sorted so the best opportunities are easy to see.

positive.prompt: How hard would it be for Abency to rank for "metricool alternative"?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the keyword difficulty score with a short explanation of what it means for a site like Abency.

positive.description: Most viewed pages in Google Analytics
positive.prompt: Which pages of Abency's website got the most views in Google Analytics last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most viewed pages of the previous month with views and users, from Google Analytics 4.
